repos.name: wzyn20051216/solidworks-automation-skill
repos.description: Reliable AI Skill + MCP toolkit for agent-driven desktop CAD automation.
repos.one_liner: An AI-driven toolkit designed to automate desktop CAD workflows using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
bullets: Built with Python, leveraging MCP to bridge AI agents with local desktop applications.
Integrates AI reasoning capabilities with SolidWorks API for complex engineering tasks.
Enables autonomous CAD design, modification, and repetitive task execution.
Targeted at industrial automation and engineering productivity workflows.

repos.name: grape-dev/grape
repos.description: AI Native DevOps —— Turn Any Git Project into an AI-Driven Development Workflow with One Click
repos.one_liner: An AI-native DevOps platform that transforms standard Git repositories into autonomous AI-driven development workflows.
bullets: Python-based architecture designed to integrate directly into existing Git-based CI/CD pipelines.
Automates code review, issue resolution, and documentation generation via LLM agents.
Reduces manual DevOps overhead by providing one-click AI workflow orchestration.
Useful for engineering teams looking to integrate agentic workflows into their existing codebase.

repos.name: zed-industries/gpui
repos.description: A GPU-accelerated, open-source UI framework for Rust that combines immediate and retained modes.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, GPU-accelerated UI framework for Rust that powers the Zed editor.
bullets: Hybrid immediate and retained mode rendering architecture optimized for low-latency performance.
Leverages hardware acceleration to handle complex UI layouts and high-frequency updates.
Provides a robust foundation for building high-performance developer tools and desktop applications.
Ideal for building next-generation fintech trading terminals or data-heavy visualization dashboards.

repos.name: shirudo-dev/shirudo
repos.one_liner: A security platform leveraging eBPF technology for deep system observability and threat detection.
bullets: Written in C, utilizing eBPF (Extended Berkeley Packet Filter) for kernel-level monitoring.
Provides real-time visibility into system calls, network traffic, and process execution.
Designed for high-security infrastructure environments requiring low-overhead monitoring.
Applicable for securing cloud-native infrastructure and detecting unauthorized system anomalies.

repos.name: Developing-Gamer/agent-sim
repos.description: iOS simulators for AI agents, on Linux
repos.one_liner: A specialized infrastructure tool that enables running iOS simulators for AI agents on Linux environments.
bullets: Rust-based implementation designed to bridge mobile simulation environments with Linux-based AI agent runners.
Facilitates the testing and deployment of agentic workflows that require mobile app interaction.
Solves cross-platform compatibility issues for developers building mobile-centric AI agents.
Critical for scaling agentic testing infrastructure without relying on macOS-only hardware.
